About RNGdle

RNGdle is a compact browser game about making one random number feel meaningful. The game rolls a number, finds numerical patterns, assigns badges, and turns those discoveries into EP.

This project is a static remake of the core play experience. It focuses on offline-friendly gameplay, local daily progress, badge scoring, and shareable roll summaries.

What this remake includes

The remake includes a daily roll, UTC reset countdown, local lifetime EP, rarity tiers, badge families, and a broad set of number-pattern checks.

It does not include live accounts, server leaderboards, social hearts, claim tokens, or friend feeds.
